# CrabVault beta 0.9.9
## General improvements
- Applies camera-image EXIF orientation before Vision OCR so rotated phone photos are recognized in their intended reading direction. - Adds Australian identity, government-card, state, and banking terms to the Vision recognition vocabulary. - Normalizes common OCR substitutions in document labels before assigning otherwise-correct values to database fields.
## Bug fixes
- Passport fields accept the common short `Expiry` label.
